1.title: Top Lawmakers Agree A.I.’s Risks Are Rising but Say They Have No Quick Fix
1.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson warned on Sunday of competitive risks from China, and Hakeem Jeffries, the minority leader, said Congress should start regulatory talks this week.

2.title: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks, citing rivalry with China
2.summary: The US President said "negative forces" were airing concerns about "things that won't happen".

3.title: US congressman swims to safety after his plane is forced to land on a lake
3.summary: The small plane carrying Rep Tom Tiffany had a mechanical issue that forced the pilot to make an emergency landing on a Wisconsin lake.

4.title: Swedish party blocs tied after Sunday vote, projections say
4.summary: With 50% of the votes counted, the two main blocs were separated by only 20,000 votes, Sweden public broadvasteer SVT said.

5.title: Meeting Between Iran, Arab States Postponed as Mideast Diplomacy Stalls
5.summary: Talks between the United States and Iran hit a dead end weeks ago, leaving Arab countries struggling to manage their ties to Tehran amid ongoing attacks.

6.title: In Doonbeg, Trump’s Irish Open Visit Prompts Protests and Praise
6.summary: As the U.S. president heads to his Doonbeg hotel for the Irish Open, locals expressed both appreciation for the resort’s economic benefits and opposition to his politics.
